## RE:volution Mod v1.4.9

### Added

- Added one-step Rune Rank Revert for one selected rune starting at the Advanced rank.
- Bound eligible rune reverts to the existing CTRL + right-click “Weaken” gesture shown in the rune UI; plain right click does not revert and the existing left-click awakening action remains unchanged.
- Added server-side validation for collection status, rune index, ownership and current rank before applying a revert.
- Added regression coverage for one-step rollback, forbidden Improved-to-Normal rollback, CTRL + right-click selection/scaling guards, factual progression and repeated revert/restore cycles.

### Fixed

- The next rune purchase price shown to the client is now derived from the same active Balance Core purchase adapter and factual per-rune progression used by server purchases.
- Reverting one rune from a full Advanced collection now immediately yields the factual Advanced-stage progression index of 25 without decrementing or persisting a hidden purchase index.
- Repeated restore/revert cycles return to the same factual progression and data-driven price point instead of accumulating hidden state.

### Other

- Rank Revert changes only the selected rune rank by one step; all other rune ranks remain unchanged.
- Existing rune enhancement levels are preserved.
- Rank Revert is free and provides no refund, reward or resource return; a later rank-up uses the normal full rank-up cost.
- The current runtime still supports Normal, Improved and Advanced ranks only; v1.4.9 does not invent a fourth rank.
- Mongo schema, Balance Core schema, Mob Balance, Admin Balance Preview/Apply and Balance Export Contract remain unchanged.

### Download

Use the matching server and client gameplay artifact published for this stable release.
